serverInfo.name: arkova
serverInfo.title: Arkova Verification MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Read Arkova verification records and search public-safe credential metadata through MCP.

tools.name: verify_credential
tools.description: Verify a credential's authenticity and current status by its public identifier. Returns verification status, issuer information, credential type, dates, and network anchoring proof.

tools.name: search_credentials
tools.description: Search anchored public credentials by keyword. The served behaviour is LEXICAL: a case-insensitive substring match on credential title/description, with no relevance score and no understanding of meaning — a query only matches text that literally appears in the record, so paraphrases and synonyms will not match, and a fragment of a longer word will. Semantic (vector) similarity is used ONLY WHEN the deployment has semantic search enabled and reachable; it is not guaranteed and must not be assumed. Every result reports `search_mode`: "lexical_substring" for the substring path, or "semantic_vector" when a real vector match ran (that mode alone carries a `similarity` score). Read `search_mode` before presenting results as semantically ranked.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., "University of Michigan computer science degree")

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Agent-friendly v2 search tool. Search organizations, anchored records, fingerprints, and documents by natural language query or exact fingerprint. Broader in scope than search_credentials, which is limited to the credential corpus — prefer this tool for general discovery.

q.description: Natural language query or exact SHA-256 fingerprint

limit.description: Maximum results to return (capped to the record search RPC ceiling)

max_results.description: Deprecated alias for limit; prefer limit for REST v2 parity

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Agent-friendly v2 verification tool. Verify whether a SHA-256 document fingerprint has been anchored. Canonical name for this capability — get_fingerprint is a documented alias returning the identical response.

tools.name: verify_document
tools.description: Verify a document by its SHA-256 fingerprint. Checks if the document has been anchored and returns the anchor proof including the network receipt and timestamp. Same underlying lookup as verify; kept for backward compatibility with earlier integrations.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the document to verify

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description: Verify multiple credentials in a single call. Accepts up to 100 public IDs and returns each result in input order. Use this when an agent needs to validate a list of credentials (e.g., a candidate portfolio, a screening pipeline batch).

public_ids.description: Array of credential public identifiers (max 100). Each is verified individually.

tools.name: oracle_batch_verify
tools.description: Batch-verify multiple credentials via the Arkova Oracle. Use for bulk verification workflows where a response envelope with query_id + per-credential results is needed. Lower item cap than verify_batch (25 vs 100) in exchange for the envelope format; returns an HMAC-signed envelope when MCP_SIGNING_KEY is provisioned, otherwise an explicit signed:false marker.

public_ids.description: Array of Arkova public IDs to verify (max 25)

tools.name: get_anchor
tools.description: Get redacted public anchor metadata by Arkova public ID. Use after search returns a public_id. Canonical name for this capability — get_record and get_document are documented aliases returning the identical response; verify_credential returns the same underlying data shaped for direct credential lookups.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get public-safe record metadata by Arkova public ID. Use after search returns a record public_id. Alias of get_anchor (identical response) kept for v2 REST parity — result-type-specific naming makes the search → get_* workflow self-documenting when an agent doesn't already know the result type.

public_id.description: Arkova public identifier returned by search

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get public-safe document metadata by Arkova public ID. Use after search returns a document public_id. Alias of get_anchor (identical response) kept for v2 REST parity — see get_record for why the alias exists.

public_id.description: Arkova public identifier returned by search

tools.name: get_fingerprint
tools.description: Get public-safe record metadata by SHA-256 fingerprint. Use after search returns a fingerprint result. Alias of verify (identical response) kept for v2 REST parity — see get_record for why the alias exists.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get organization profile details by organization public_id. Use after search returns an organization public_id.

public_id.description: Organization public identifier returned by search

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: List the organizations available to the authenticated caller. Use to establish org context before scoped searches.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List AI agents registered to the authenticated caller's organization. Returns agent names, types, scopes, and status.

tools.name: nessie_query
tools.description: DISABLED. Arkova's Nessie intelligence engine is not currently served: this tool returns an explicit `nessie_disabled` error, never results. It does not search, and an empty answer from it must not be read as "no matching documents". Use `search` or `search_credentials` for record lookup instead.

mode.description: "retrieval" returns raw ranked documents; "context" returns a synthesized answer with citations

tools.name: anchor_document
tools.description: Submit a document fingerprint for anchoring to the public ledger. The document itself is never sent — only its SHA-256 fingerprint. Returns an anchor receipt with a public identifier for later verification. Conditionally available: registered only when MCP_ENABLE_ANCHOR_DOCUMENT=true and the caller holds a write:anchors or anchor:write scope. Absent that, this tool will not appear in a live tools/list call even though it is part of the documented server surface.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the document content
